name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3330: HEART: this version adds a BANK-TIME refusal and touches no user-facing surface. The bible.html change is the version stamp alone. Its watcher is the gate test_version_not_banked_into_graded_tree, newly registered, whose join case pins that bump_version still consults tree_busy. The pre-push gate grades the WORKING TREE and not the commit, so a bump landing while a gate runs makes that green verdict describe bytes which are not the ones shipping. The tree lock was believed to be the signal and it is NOT SUFFICIENT. MEASURED during the live v3328 push: the gate flock read FREE while a pre-push had been grading for 15 minutes with Playwright smoke in flight. The lock is taken by run_gates, and the hook runs its browser smoke OUTSIDE that claim, so the exact window that matters most reads as unlocked. tree_busy.why now asks TWO independent questions, the flock AND a running pre-push, and returns a REASON rather than a bare bool. Three states: free is a measurement, busy names which signal fired, and UNKNOWN is NOT FREE because a check that cannot tell must refuse rather than wave the bank through. It releases the flock the moment it has tested it, since holding it would make the guard the collision it exists to prevent. 3 red-proofs PROVEN, and the middle one came back BLIND on its first cut: the join case asserted that three names APPEAR in bump_version, and every one of them survives turning the live condition into a constant, so the refusal became dead code while the law stayed green. It now anchors the live condition and requires the raise inside that branch.
